title: Catalog Reconciler
user: Collectors moving a personal catalog between spreadsheets, Homebox, Koillection, or a new system who need to import without silently creating or renumbering records.
smallest_useful_product: Local drag-and-drop CSV/JSON preflight that maps columns, normalizes identifiers, reports added/changed/missing/colliding rows, and emits a reviewed import file.
constraints: Process files locally in-browser by default; document CSV formula-injection handling; never require marketplace credentials.
